channel.title: The Logical Indian - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Logical Indian (thelogicalindian.com)

item.title: Tamil Nadu On High Alert After Hundreds Of Dead Crows In Chennai Test Positive For Bird Flu Virus
item.description: Tamil Nadu authorities intensified surveillance after H5N1 bird flu was confirmed in hundreds of dead crows across Chennai.

item.title: Epstein Files Spark Fresh Debate as Bill Gates Denies Allegations, Expresses Regret Over Past Association
item.description: Bill Gates rejects claims linked to newly released Epstein documents, while Melinda French Gates speaks emotionally as renewed scrutiny fuels debate over power, accountability and justice.

item.title: Broad-Daylight Killing: Aam Aadmi Party Leader Lucky Oberoi Shot Dead Outside Jalandhar Gurdwara, Punjab
item.description: AAP functionary Lucky Oberoi was fatally shot by unidentified attackers outside a gurdwara in Jalandhar, prompting a police investigation and political outrage.

item.title: Personal Loan Overview: Benefits, Eligibility and Interest Rates
item.description: Personal loans are emerging as flexible financial tools for Indians facing emergencies, goals, and short-term funding gaps.

item.title: Iran Formally Allows Women to Ride Motorcycles, Ending Years of Legal Ambiguity and Securing Licences
item.description: Iran has formally allowed women to obtain motorcycle licences, ending years of informal restrictions despite no explicit legal ban.

item.title: Hyderabad Software Engineer, 31, Dies by Suicide After Difficulty Adjusting to New Job Role
item.description: A 31-year-old Hyderabad-based software engineer allegedly died by suicide after reportedly struggling to manage new job responsibilities, police said.

item.title: RBI Keeps Repo Rate Unchanged at 5.25%, Governor Sanjay Malhotra Says; Inflation Seen at 2.1% in FY26
item.description: The RBI’s Monetary Policy Committee has retained the repo rate at 5.25%, citing controlled inflation, steady growth, and global economic uncertainties.

item.title: ‘No Sexual Intent’: Indian Restaurateur Vikas Nath Admits to Spiking Woman’s Drink at London Club
item.description: Restaurateur Vikas Nath admitted to spiking a woman's drink at Annabel's but denied any sexual intent.

item.title: Himachal Pradesh Bans Mobile Phones in Schools from March 2026 to Boost Focus, Discipline
item.description: Himachal Pradesh will ban mobile phones in all schools from March 1 to curb academic distractions.

item.title: Justice After 40 Years: Allahabad HC Acquits 100-Year-Old Man In 1982 Murder Case
item.description: After an appeal remained pending for more than four decades, the Allahabad High Court acquitted a 100-year-old man, citing judicial delay and lack of conclusive evidence.
